update_channel.name: Update Channel
update_channel.description: Selects which update channel DLL Bot should use.

keybind_open_menu.name: Open Menu
keybind_open_menu.description: Opens or closes the DLL Bot menu.

keybind_toggle_macro.name: Toggle Macro
keybind_toggle_macro.description: Turns macro playback on or off.

keybind_toggle_autoclicker.name: Toggle Autoclicker
keybind_toggle_autoclicker.description: Turns the autoclicker on or off.

keybind_toggle_stepper.name: Toggle Frame Stepper
keybind_toggle_stepper.description: Turns the frame stepper on or off.

keybind_step_forward.name: Step Forward
keybind_step_forward.description: Steps one frame forward when the frame stepper is enabled.

editor_keybinds.name: Keybinds on editor
editor_keybinds.description: Enables keybinds while on the level editor.

recording_only_keybinds.name: Keybinds only while recording
recording_only_keybinds.description: Keybinds only work while recording a macro.

frame_offset.name: Frame Offset
frame_offset.description: Adds a frame offset when recording or playing macros

sync_tps_fps.name: Sync TPS With FPS
sync_tps_fps.description: Synchronizes the rendering FPS with the target TPS of the TPS Bypass

endscreen_button.name: Button at Endscreen
endscreen_button.description: Shows the menu button at the endscreen.

ffmpeg_path.name: ffmpeg.exe Path
ffmpeg_path.description: The path for ffmpeg.exe, needed to use render.

disable_speedhack.name: Auto Disable Speedhack
disable_speedhack.description: Disables Speedhack when exiting a level.

auto_stop_playing.name: Auto Stop Playing
auto_stop_playing.description: Stops playing the macro when it ends.

frame_fixes_limit.name: Frame Fixes Limit in FPS
frame_fixes_limit.description: Limits how many frame fixes per second there will be.

macro_step_shift_enabled.name: Custom Step Size
macro_step_shift_enabled.description: Enables holding Shift to step a custom amount of frames.

macro_step_shift_size.name: Step Size Amount
macro_step_shift_size.description: Amount of frames to step when holding shift.

macro_hold_step_size.name: Hold Step Amount
macro_hold_step_size.description: How many frames to step forward per tick while holding the frame stepper key.

macro_hold_step_delay.name: Hold Step Delay (ms)
macro_hold_step_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds between steps when holding the frame stepper key.

mobile_record_audio_fix.name: Mobile Record Audio Fix
mobile_record_audio_fix.description: Changes how mobile Record Audio avoids ultra-fast audio in renders.

default_macro_format.name: Default Macro Format
default_macro_format.description: Sets the default format used when saving macros.

macro_index_url.name: Macro Index URL
macro_index_url.description: URL to the macro index JSON file. Change to a custom index if self-hosting.

rgb_ui.name: RGB UI
rgb_ui.description: Change the bot's UI color to a continuous RGB cycle effect instead of a static color.

menu_background_opacity.name: Menu background opacity
menu_background_opacity.description: Opacity of the main DLL Bot menu background.

menu_glow_enabled.name: Animated glow background
menu_glow_enabled.description: Shows the moving glow balls behind the menu.

menu_glow_opacity.name: Glow opacity
menu_glow_opacity.description: Opacity of the animated glow balls.

level_settings_button.name: Show Button At Settings
level_settings_button.description: Shows the DLL Bot button in the level settings layer.

restore_page.name: Restore Settings Page
restore_page.description: Saves the page you were in when you closed the menu.

homeless_pbo.name: homeless: Fast PBO Frame Capture
homeless_pbo.description: Asynchronously reads frames from the GPU to prevent game freezes during rendering. Speeds up rendering significantly.

homeless_multithreading.name: homeless: Multithreaded Render Queue
homeless_multithreading.description: Sends captured frames to a background thread queue instead of blocking the game process.

homeless_hw_accel.name: homeless: Hardware Acceleration
homeless_hw_accel.description: Selects the video codec. CPU is the slowest, NVIDIA/AMD uses your GPU video chip.

homeless_aggressive_presets.name: homeless: Aggressive Presets (CPU)
homeless_aggressive_presets.description: Sets FFmpeg to 'ultrafast'. Massive speed boost for CPU rendering at the cost of larger file size.

homeless_vflip_manual.name: homeless: Fast C++ VFlip
homeless_vflip_manual.description: Flips the image in code instead of using FFmpeg's video filter. Saves filtering time.
